body.zh-HK:
> 面試官問：「講一次你因為 evidence 而改變技術決定的經驗。」
>
> 答啱一半嘅答案：「我很有 ownership，所以最後做成功。」

Ownership 係一個形容詞，不是能被追問的 project story。面試官想知道的是：你原本面對甚麼決定、當時有哪些合理選項、你看了甚麼 evidence、哪個結果令你改變方向、以及改完後還有哪些限制。即使只有 synthetic portfolio project，也可以誠實講一個可重現的 decision，而不用杜撰公司影響或把一張好看的 demo 當成果。

## 由一個決定，不是由 technology stack 開始

選一個範圍窄的故事。例如：『我本來打算讓 assistant 直接給出 policy conclusion；固定 cases 顯示有衝突 source 時，它會把兩條規則融合成自信答案，所以我改為附引用的 draft 加 owner handoff。』這已經有 context、初始設計、failure、改動和 non-goal。RAG、model 或 vector database 只在它們解釋該決定時才提；不要用元件清單代替因果。

## 把 evidence 講成可以翻查的時間線

用四個 checkpoint 組織 90 秒：一個 user decision 和 baseline；一個候選方案和風險假設；一組固定 cases／trace／reviewer feedback；一個改動後的 comparison 和未解決限制。每個 checkpoint 放一件 artefact：problem brief、fixture manifest、decision record、before/after report、或被拒絕的 case。這讓對方可以追問『那個 case 是甚麼？』『為何不是另一個方案？』『誰有權接受風險？』而你的回答不會飄回個人特質。

## 反例令故事可信

一定留一個不成功的例子：candidate score 較高但超出 reviewer capacity、長 context 令引用變舊、或 router 降低成本卻把高風險 request 送錯路。說清楚你怎樣收窄範圍、保留 baseline、增加 handoff 或暫停 route。反例不是自我批評表演；它展示你知道 system 在哪裡不適用，和怎樣避免在真正用戶身上盲試。

## Role fit 要回到工作方式

然後才把故事連到目標角色：若職位重視 applied delivery，指出你如何對齊 user、owner 和可逆 rollout；若重視 ML platform，指出版本、eval、trace 和 reusable contract；若重視 client-facing work，指出你怎樣交代未知與建立安全的 next experiment。不要聲稱某公司一定會問這條題，也不要把 portfolio 的 synthetic signal 說成 business value。

## 可以帶入面試的證據包

- **工程：** README 的 problem／non-goal、fixture list、baseline/candidate diff、trace 或 test output、decision record。
- **交付：** 目標 user、reviewer／owner、capacity 或 cost constraint、handoff、rollback 或停用條件。
- **誠實邊界：** data 是否 synthetic、甚麼未量度、哪個 case 仍然失敗，以及你下一步只會驗證甚麼。

## 延伸閱讀

[Project story 要有一個反例](/zh-HK/interview-lab/a-project-story-needs-a-counterexample)、[Model metric 唔等於 business metric](/zh-HK/interview-lab/a-model-metric-is-not-a-business-metric)、[turn course work into an eight-week evidence sprint](/zh-HK/articles/turn-an-ai-course-into-an-eight-week-evidence-sprint) 和 [portfolio evidence planner](/zh-HK/portfolio-evidence-planner)。

## 範圍說明

這是 AI.DOG 的單題練習。project、data、metrics、artefacts 和 outcomes 均為 synthetic 教學例子；它不代表個人工作經歷、公司成果或現時招聘預測。

> 面试官问：“说一次你因为 evidence 而改变技术决定的经验。”
>
> 答对一半的答案：“我很有 ownership，所以最后做成功。”

Ownership 是形容词，不是能被追问的 project story。面试官想知道的是：你原本面对什么决策、当时有哪些合理选项、看了什么 evidence、哪个结果让你改变方向，以及改完后还有哪些限制。即使只有 synthetic portfolio project，也能诚实讲一个可重现的 decision，不必杜撰公司影响或把漂亮 demo 当成果。

选一个范围窄的故事。例如：‘我原本打算让 assistant 直接给出 policy conclusion；固定 cases 显示有冲突 source 时，它会把两条规则融合成自信答案，所以我改为附引用的 draft 加 owner handoff。’这已经有 context、初始设计、failure、改动与 non-goal。RAG、model 或 vector database 只在它们能解释该决策时才提；不要用组件清单代替因果。

用四个 checkpoint 组织 90 秒：一个 user decision 与 baseline；一个候选方案与风险假设；一组固定 cases／trace／reviewer feedback；一个改动后 comparison 与未解决限制。每个 checkpoint 放一件 artefact：problem brief、fixture manifest、decision record、before/after report，或被拒绝的 case。这让对方能追问‘那个 case 是什么？’‘为何不是另一个方案？’‘谁有权接受风险？’而你的回答不会飘回个人特质。

body.en:
> Interviewer asks: “Tell me about a time evidence changed your technical decision.”
>
> Half-right answer: “I have strong ownership, so I made it succeed.”

Ownership is an adjective, not a project story someone can probe. An interviewer wants to know which decision you faced, which alternatives were reasonable, what evidence you inspected, what result changed your direction, and which limitations remained. Even a synthetic portfolio project can tell an honest, reproducible decision story without inventing company impact or treating a polished demo as an outcome.

## Start with one decision, not a technology stack

Choose a narrowly scoped story. For example: ‘I planned to let an assistant state a policy conclusion directly. Fixed cases showed that conflicting sources were blended into a confident answer, so I changed it to a cited draft with owner handoff.’ That already contains context, initial design, failure, change and non-goal. Mention RAG, a model or a vector database only when it explains the decision; a component list is not causality.

## Tell evidence as a traceable timeline

Organise ninety seconds around four checkpoints: a user decision and baseline; a candidate approach and risk hypothesis; fixed cases, traces or reviewer feedback; and a post-change comparison with an unresolved limitation. Attach one artefact to each: a problem brief, fixture manifest, decision record, before/after report or rejected case. That invites useful questions—what was the case, why not the other option, who could accept the risk—instead of pulling you back to a personality claim.

## A counterexample makes the story believable

Keep one case that did not work: a candidate score rises but exceeds reviewer capacity; longer context makes citations stale; a router lowers cost but sends a high-risk request down the wrong route. Explain how you narrowed scope, retained a baseline, added handoff or paused the route. A counterexample is not a performance of self-criticism. It shows where the system does not apply and how you avoid blind experimentation on real users.

## Bring role fit back to working style

Only then connect the story to the target role. For applied delivery, show how you aligned user, owner and reversible rollout. For an ML platform role, show versioning, evaluation, traces and reusable contracts. For client-facing work, show how you state unknowns and build a safe next experiment. Do not claim a company will ask this question or present a portfolio’s synthetic signal as business value.

## An evidence pack to take into an interview

- **Engineering:** README problem/non-goal, fixture list, baseline/candidate diff, trace or test output and decision record.
- **Delivery:** target user, reviewer/owner, capacity or cost constraint, handoff, rollback or disable condition.
- **Honest boundary:** whether data is synthetic, what was not measured, which case still fails, and exactly what the next step would validate.

## Further reading

[A project story needs a counterexample](/en/interview-lab/a-project-story-needs-a-counterexample), [A model metric is not a business metric](/en/interview-lab/a-model-metric-is-not-a-business-metric), [turn course work into an eight-week evidence sprint](/en/articles/turn-an-ai-course-into-an-eight-week-evidence-sprint), and [the portfolio evidence planner](/en/portfolio-evidence-planner).

## Scope note

This is an AI.DOG single-question practice exercise. Projects, data, metrics, artefacts and outcomes are synthetic teaching examples; they do not represent personal work history, company results or a current hiring prediction.
